reason: The terminal shell and legacy nebula-chat client read Core's 202 chat receipt (a cold project's worker not started within 15 s) as an empty event stream and reported a lost connection, restored the accepted message and lost the new chat's identity. Both now follow the receipt into GET /runtime/requests/{id}/response without resending, and the TUI shows Core's queue reason beside the position. Selected: the terminal shell, transport and TUI suites (new receipt-following, no-resend and queue-reason tests) and the legacy chat client suite.
exclusions: tests/test_terminal_package.py, tests/v3/test_chat_cli_core.py and tests/v3/test_terminal_core.py fail or error identically on pristine origin/main in this environment (packaging and installed-client requirements) and are not selected. No Core, UI, native or Playwright change: the GUI already follows receipts.
